scoped_4090_followup.change: Independent semantic port of dd5206f05d48227c6488ef25a3284dfe8bf35243: /health reports EngineCore stopping/failed state under queue_mutex_. No cache, allocator, residency, model, or pool configuration change.

commit_dispositions.subject: Chunk KV snapshot staging to bounded page batches
commit_dispositions.disposition: Bounded-transfer intent already met by a different implementation. checkpoint_continuation (program_impl.h:8599-8773) exports text/backend KV one physical page at a time, reuses current host replicas, and allocates at most a one-page temporary host extent on the device-resident path. restore_continuation (:8777 onward) reads directly into reserved host extents in chunks no larger than staging_bytes. Neither path allocates a whole-snapshot CUDA staging buffer. Do not reintroduce the obsolete snapshot_lane/start_prefill disk-cache path.

commit_dispositions.subject: Correct MTP restore stride and streamline chunked save staging
commit_dispositions.disposition: Correct geometric stride is already enforced independently. restore_kv inside restore_continuation uses host_kv_extents->page_layout(pages).page_stride and requires file_size == kv_pages_for_frontier(frontier) * page_stride. Text and backend layouts are resolved independently. It never divides total saved MTP bytes by the number of restored pages. Save staging is already independent of the obsolete pinned-buffer inner loop. Preserve this implementation; do not add the upstream test wholesale because it exercises a different pool/API.

commit_dispositions.subject: Publish snapshot saves whose write already finished
commit_dispositions.disposition: Intent already present, with stronger durable-publication machinery. That file/class is absent at e5630a74. SessionCheckpointStore::save (src/serve/session_checkpoint_store.cpp:1275-1423) waits for BufferedCheckpointWriter::finish, completes and validates payloads, syncs manifest, publishes generation, atomically replaces current, and returns success despite best-effort post-publication reclamation failure. There is no request-arrival cancel_requested_ check discarding a completed write. Preserve legitimate pre-publication quota/error refusal; it is not the upstream latency-priority cancellation bug.

commit_dispositions.subject: Opt-in WDDM budgeting, residency fence wait, correct CUDA import flags
commit_dispositions.disposition: The safe default is already the only allocation policy: DeviceArena::DeviceArena (arena.cu:141) calls cudaMalloc, without eager arena touch-fill; registry.cpp:70-87 budgets measured free bytes, and construct_registered remeasures after weight materialization. No D3D12 allocation, import flags, residency fence, evictable-budget option, or planned-budget global exists. Do not add a35acf6a merely to make its repairs applicable.

commit_dispositions.subject: Verify imported D3D12 arena round-trip
commit_dispositions.disposition: Not applicable to current cudaMalloc allocator. If D3D12 is intentionally introduced later, this is a required safety component, together with the later synchronization and cleanup fixes—not a standalone performance patch.

commit_dispositions.subject: Promote evictable budgeting to explicit CLI option
commit_dispositions.disposition: Defer with the D3D12 subsystem. It is a new exposed policy, not needed to preserve existing behavior. Also do not mechanically import its unrelated removal of automatic-KV option validation from registry.cpp.

commit_dispositions.subject: Drain WDDM touch-fill before publishing arena pointers
commit_dispositions.disposition: The two touch-fill races cannot occur in the current constructor because those fills do not exist. PinnedHostBuffer already uses cudaMallocHost, matching the useful final host-buffer behavior. Separately preserve db343a9ade035a7e071b7f526777783c41b7c1ff: DeviceBuffer::copy_from_host synchronizes the default stream before callers launch non-blocking-stream consumers. That is present, but is not a substitute for a future D3D12 fill fence.

commit_dispositions.subject: D3D12 fallback cleanup and physical-VRAM guards
commit_dispositions.disposition: No failing external-memory mapping exists to clean up downstream. The standalone constructor guard is absent and portable, but our shipped path already rejects impossible capacity through measured-free preflight and post-weight KV resolution. Do not count it as a demonstrated cache/residency win; include only if the implementation scope explicitly wants a generic DeviceArena contract change and a direct oversize-allocation scenario justifies it. Upstream's claim that cudaGetLastError leaves a faulted context pristine is not locally validated by this investigation.

commit_dispositions.subject: Treat transient admission shortfall as scheduling, not permanent executor failure
commit_dispositions.disposition: Original exception site and ConcurrentExecutor are gone. Equivalent stale-reservation handling exists in ResourceManager::reserve_materialization (resource_manager.h:415-443): resource revision mismatch returns Stale, and aborted reservation rolls back. EngineCore::admit_planned_request (engine_core.h:1488 onward) requests another admission check on Stale. try_admit_one turns PermanentlyInfeasible into request-local ContextLengthExceeded and applies pending deadlines. Preserve these rather than transplant old lane-plan code.

measurement.interpretation: One C1 sample per candidate; no statistically supported performance improvement claimed. Health query changes no inference scheduling or cache behavior.

limitations: Normal /health exercised by actual lifecycle qualification; failed/stopping 503 path was not induced on hardware.
No D3D12/WDDM allocator introduced; related fixes remain inapplicable or deferred.
No artifact-v3 migration or kernel-retune campaign.
Qualification summary retained under local orchestrator state; public release not cut.

title: What the upstream backlogs can still contribute as cherry-picks
method: Every commit the dated watch recommends was applied to our fork tip with `git cherry-pick -n -x` in a scratch worktree and then reverted. A clean pick with an empty index means the change is already in our tree; a clean pick with staged files means it still applies; anything else records the conflicting paths. Nothing was committed and no tree was left modified.

ninfer_4090.finding: The nine clean-applying commits are all kernel retunes. Everything this lane actually wants - chunked KV snapshot staging, the MTP restore stride fix, publishing snapshot saves whose write already finished, WDDM residency budgeting, the D3D12 residency fence, the admission-shortfall fix and the /health executor state - sits in the conflicting 41, in the same files this fork has changed. Those are a rebase, not a cherry-pick.

disposition: The 2026-08-30 campaign plan in omp-ninfer#33 is superseded. Selective backporting is no longer the economic lane on either fork: on the RTX 5090 the clean set is product-inert, and on the RTX 4090 the valuable set conflicts by construction. What remains worth doing is a scoped rebase per lane, each landing measured and requalified, with upstream's artifact v3 migration treated as its own project rather than a side effect.
